import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] boardA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] boardB = new char[12][12];
    static int dim, limit;
    static boolean[][][][][] seen = new boolean[71][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] accessible = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] timeCost = new int[12][12];
    static List<List<Integer>> network = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] cap = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] f = new int[210][210];
    static int[] supply = new int[210];
    static int[] level = new int[210];
    static int[][] vertex = new int[11][11];

    static void trace(int step, int r, int c, int sr, int sc) {
        if (limit >= 70) return;
        if (r < 0 || r >= dim || c < 0 || c >= dim) return;
        if (boardA[r][c] < '0' || boardA[r][c] > '9') return;
        if (step > limit + 1) return;
        if (seen[step][r][c][sr][sc]) return;
        if (step > timeCost[r][c] && timeCost[r][c] != 0) return;
        if (step == timeCost[r][c] && timeCost[r][c] != 0 && (boardB[r][c] > '9' || boardB[r][c] <= '0')) return;
        seen[step][r][c][sr][sc] = true;
        if (step < timeCost[r][c]) {
            trace(step + 1, r, c, sr, sc);
            trace(step + 1, r + 1, c, sr, sc);
            trace(step + 1, r - 1, c, sr, sc);
            trace(step + 1, r, c + 1, sr, sc);
            trace(step + 1, r, c - 1, sr, sc);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        dim = scanner.nextInt();
        limit = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                boardA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                boardB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j) {
                timeCost[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (boardA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    timeCost[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0];
            int c = cell[1];
            if (timeCost[r][c] >= limit) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nr = r + dr[d];
                int nc = c + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < dim && nc >= 0 && nc < dim &&
                    boardA[nr][nc] >= '0' && boardA[nr][nc] <= '9' && timeCost[nr][nc] == -1) {
                    timeCost[nr][nc] = timeCost[r][c] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (timeCost[i][j] == -1) timeCost[i][j] = limit;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {
                if (boardA[i][j] >= '0' && boardA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    trace(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < dim; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < dim; ++j1) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < dim; ++i2) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < dim; ++j2) {
                        for (int s = 0; s <= limit; ++s) {
                            if (seen[s][i1][j1][i2][j2]) {
                                accessible[i1][j1][i2][j2] = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        network.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < dim; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < dim; ++j1) {
                if (boardA[i1][j1] > '0' && boardA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int u = network.size();
                    network.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    supply[u] = boardA[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < dim; ++i2) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < dim; ++j2) {
                            if (boardB[i2][j2] > '0' && boardB[i2][j2] <= '9' && accessible[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int v;
                                if (vertex[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    vertex[i2][j2] = network.size();
                                    network.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                }
                                v = vertex[i2][j2];
                                network.get(u).add(v);
                                network.get(v).add(u);
                                cap[u][v] = 10000;
                                cap[v][u] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < dim; ++i2) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < dim; ++j2) {
                if (boardB[i2][j2] > '0' && boardB[i2][j2] <= '9' && vertex[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int v = vertex[i2][j2];
                    network.get(v).add(0);
                    cap[v][0] = boardB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    cap[0][v] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < network.size(); ++i) {
            level[i] = 0;
        }
        level[0] = network.size();

        while (true) {
            boolean modified = false;
            for (int u = 1; u < network.size(); ++u) {
                while (supply[u] > 0) {
                    boolean pushed = false;
                    int minL = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v : network.get(u)) {
                        if (cap[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0) {
                            minL = Math.min(minL, level[v]);
                        }
                        if (cap[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && level[u] == level[v] + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(cap[u][v] - f[u][v], supply[u]);
                            f[u][v] += delta;
                            f[v][u] -= delta;
                            supply[u] -= delta;
                            supply[v] += delta;
                            pushed = true;
                            modified = true;
                            if (supply[u] == 0) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (level[u] != minL + 1 && minL != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        level[u] = minL + 1;
                        modified = true;
                    }
                    if (!pushed) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!modified) {
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(supply[0]);
    }
}
